scope: User-authorized read-only app/process resource sampling, bounded configured log inspection, source fixes and regression checks. No desktop build, app restart/install, live-provider mutation or UI/CDP automation.

laterSameProcessMemorySnapshot.scope: Known sampled processes only; not a refreshed descendant inventory or another test-free CPU sample; summed working sets can double-count shared pages; snapshots do not establish leak-free behavior

sourceFixes.change: Removed two discarded full request/history clones. Canonical model-only borrowed resolver is shared with mutating mapping; native narrower precedence remains intact.

sourceFixes.compatibilityBoundary: Unavailable bounded pagination refuses recovery without mutation; no full-history fallback. Genuine active/nonterminal thread recovery remains refused.

sourceFixes.liveBoundary: Live sample covered three model routes, not all ten families. Additional compaction source fixes have not been installed by this task.

sourceFixes.change: Use existing request health trace for stream errors/retry decisions/fixed-enum final observed outcome. Retry decision uses same unlimited-aware budget predicate as execution. No extra payload parsing or whole-history storage.
sourceFixes.outcomeBoundary: Proxy-observed terminal/cancellation/unknown is not client delivery acknowledgement. Earlier three capacity retries remain historically unproven; upstream capacity limits are not eliminated.
